sessions.phase_label: Initial feature discovery and quote-calculator scoping
Website development, responsive implementation, and domain deployment
Runtime review, gallery fixes, mobile decisions, and image population

requirements.title: Instant Quote Calculator
requirements.definition: An interactive survey-style calculator that derives an estimated price from selected services, property size, bundle eligibility, travel distance, surcharges, and discounts.
requirements.boundary_note: Pricing tiers, service add-ons, bundle qualification, distance surcharge, and total generation are attributes of one calculator mechanism. The static pricing-page presentation and later basic quote form are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Interactive Gallery Browsing
requirements.definition: The gallery must provide functional interactive browsing and scrolling without user-visible glitches.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers core gallery browsing behavior and its runtime malfunction; category taxonomy, hover effects, image content, and video placement can change independently.

requirements.title: Homepage Hero Presentation
requirements.definition: The homepage hero should emphasize its image using a subtle low-opacity blue overlay and an appropriate house-oriented image.
requirements.boundary_note: Overlay color, opacity, and hero-image subject are presentation attributes of the same hero mechanism; homepage navigation and video placement remain separate.

requirements.title: Package and Square-Footage Pricing Display
requirements.definition: The pricing interface must present four service packages and display the applicable package prices for four square-footage ranges.
requirements.boundary_note: Package count, square-footage ranges, and package rates are attributes of one static pricing-display mechanism. This is distinct from the deferred dynamic calculator and individual-service price breakdown.

requirements.title: Homepage Page-Link Buttons
requirements.definition: Homepage buttons must navigate to their corresponding Gallery, Pricing, Services, or detailed-pricing destinations instead of returning users to the top of the homepage.
requirements.boundary_note: The destination map for the main homepage buttons is one navigation mechanism. Portfolio tiles and the Book a Session CTA are separately implemented and discussed navigation behaviors.

requirements.title: Image-Focused Site Presentation
requirements.definition: Pages throughout the website should use a highly visual, photography-focused presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the site-wide visual-density and emphasis constraint; requirements governing exact service imagery, gallery content, and the homepage hero remain independently actionable.

requirements.title: Service-Specific Imagery
requirements.definition: Each offered service on the Services page should be accompanied by a corresponding representative image.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers semantic matching of images to individual services, not the general image-focused design principle or gallery image inventory.

requirements.title: One-Time Pricing Model
requirements.definition: The website must represent service pricing as one-time charges and must not present monthly or annual subscription tabs.
requirements.boundary_note: The one-time business model can change independently of package counts, exact rates, and mobile table interaction.

requirements.title: Individual Service Pricing Transparency
requirements.definition: The pricing page should visibly itemize individual services and their pricing so customers can understand the breakdown and select services outside a bundle.
requirements.boundary_note: The individual-service diagram and price breakdown are independently useful even if package pricing remains unchanged.

requirements.title: Gallery Category Filters
requirements.definition: The gallery should organize portfolio media through the requested category tabs, including photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3D tours, with optional space for other photography.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers category organization and filter taxonomy; core gallery operation, hover behavior, image population, and placement of video among pictures are separate concerns.

requirements.title: Portfolio Hover Animations
requirements.definition: Portfolio and gallery items should use hover animation effects, subject to the client decision about whether the same effects remain on touch and mobile layouts.
requirements.boundary_note: Animation behavior can be modified or removed independently of gallery browsing, media content, and category filters.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Table Interaction
requirements.definition: The pricing table must remain readable on small screens using an accepted mobile interaction such as horizontal scrolling or a fixed first column.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile table interaction is independently adjustable without changing the underlying packages, rates, or one-time pricing model.

requirements.title: Responsive Site Layout
requirements.definition: The implemented website should render responsively on standard desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the general cross-device layout behavior; feature-specific mobile decisions such as pricing-table scrolling and hover effects remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Gallery Portfolio Image Content
requirements.definition: The gallery should be populated with the client's final portfolio photographs rather than placeholder imagery, with enough images to form a balanced portfolio.
requirements.boundary_note: Gallery image population is separate from gallery browsing logic and from selecting supplied photographs for non-gallery sections.

requirements.title: Client-Supplied Images for Site Sections
requirements.definition: Homepage, Services, and other non-gallery sections should use suitable client-supplied photographs in place of inappropriate stock images.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the source and selection of imagery outside the gallery; semantic service-to-image matching and the homepage hero treatment remain separate.

requirements.title: Homepage Portfolio Tile Links
requirements.definition: Portfolio tiles displayed on the homepage must link visitors to the gallery.
requirements.boundary_note: Portfolio-tile linking has its own implementation trajectory and is separate from the main homepage page-navigation buttons.

requirements.title: Homepage Portfolio Video
requirements.definition: A portfolio video may be displayed beside the homepage portfolio photographs, independently of video content in the gallery.
requirements.boundary_note: Homepage and gallery video placement must be separate Requirements because the client later removes only the homepage video while retaining the gallery video.

requirements.title: Gallery Portfolio Video
requirements.definition: Portfolio video should be integrated into the Gallery alongside the photographs rather than isolated in a separate video tab.
requirements.boundary_note: Gallery video remains required after the homepage video is removed, demonstrating an independent lifecycle.

requirements.title: Book a Session CTA Destination
requirements.definition: The Book a Session button must direct visitors to a usable lead-capture or scheduling destination rather than remain without a defined target.
requirements.boundary_note: Button destination behavior is independent of whether Calendly is integrated and independent of the fields or styling of the eventual quote form.

requirements.title: Calendly Scheduling Integration
requirements.definition: The site may provide a Calendly scheduling link as a booking option, subject to the client's later decision to omit it for the current implementation.
requirements.boundary_note: Calendly can be independently included, removed, or added later while the quote form and CTA continue to exist.

requirements.title: Get a Quote Form Fields
requirements.definition: A dedicated Get a Quote page must provide a form collecting name, optional company, phone number, email, and job description.
requirements.boundary_note: The page purpose and requested field schema form one data-collection mechanism; Calendly scheduling and visual brand styling can change independently.

requirements.title: Brand-Consistent Quote Form Styling
requirements.definition: The Get a Quote form must visually match the existing website brand through consistent layout, typography, colors, buttons, and general appearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Brand styling has an independently testable visual acceptance criterion and is separate from the form's required data fields.

unresolved_candidates.description: The exact gallery failure mode is shown only in an unavailable recording, so later extraction should avoid attributing the glitch to scrolling, filtering, animation, or image loading more narrowly than the text supports.
After Calendly is excluded, the messages do not explicitly confirm whether the Book a Session CTA will point to the new Get a Quote page; the final destination remains uncertain.
